knxUltimateUtility.legacy_notice: This node is deprecated and remains supported for existing flows. Use KNX Utility for new flows. The button below converts all compatible legacy KNX utility nodes in every flow and subflow.
knxUltimateUtility.migration_button: Convert all compatible legacy KNX nodes
knxUltimateUtility.migration_button_title: Convert every compatible legacy KNX utility instance in all editor flows and subflows to KNX Utility
knxUltimateUtility.migration_confirm: Convert all {{count}} compatible legacy KNX utility nodes in every flow and subflow to KNX Utility? The current node editor will close and discard unsaved edits. IDs, settings, connections and groups are preserved. Conversion happens in this browser, can be undone, and takes effect when you Deploy. Before conversion, a JSON backup download of all current editor flows will start automatically. Protected credentials are excluded, as in the standard Node-RED export. Your browser may ask where to save the file.
knxUltimateUtility.migration_none: No compatible legacy KNX utility nodes were found.
knxUltimateUtility.migration_success: The flow backup download has started. {{count}} nodes converted to KNX Utility. Review the result and click Deploy to apply it. You can undo the conversion with Undo.
knxUltimateUtility.migration_backup_failed: Flow backup could not be started. No nodes were converted:

startup_migration.title: Legacy KNX Ultimate nodes
startup_migration.message: Legacy nodes found in your flows and subflows: HUE: {{hue}}; KNX utility: {{knx}}. These nodes still work, but are hidden from the palette. Migrate them to HUE Controller and KNX Utility. Each migration downloads a flow backup; review the result before deploying.
startup_migration.unavailable: The migration tool is unavailable. Reload the editor after restarting Node-RED.
